user.title: Melodious hub
user.description: Home Assistant entities become devices on your Melodious Harmony hub, for activities and remote buttons. The hub calls Home Assistant back over plain http, so give an address the hub can reach on your network.

data.username: Hub username (if the web UI has a password)
data.ha_url: Home Assistant URL for the hub (http://…)

error.http_only: Use a plain http:// address; the hub can't check https certificates.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.

init.title: Devices on the hub
init.description: Pick whole devices to merge into one Harmony device each, and/or single entities. The next step reviews each device. Removing one takes it off the hub, unless an activity or button still uses it.

data.devices: Devices (merged into one Harmony device each)
data.edit_theater_links: Edit LG HDMI device links (display only)

review.title: Review merged devices
review.description: Per device: which entities to merge, and which commands to leave off the hub.{warnings}

data.edit_theater_links: Link LG HDMI ports to hub devices (display only)

theater.title: Link LG HDMI gear
theater.description: For each HDMI port, optionally select existing hub devices whose screens should show the TV's observations. Links do not change commands, activities or power control. Turn the TV on yourself for first-time port discovery. ARC volume is TV-reported, not independently measured soundbar volume; power stays unknown.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the hub. Try again.
error.unknown_device: A selected hub device no longer exists. Select it again.
